hooks.command: sh -c 'cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)" || exit 0; repo=$(basename "$PWD"); branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null | tr / -); out="$HOME/.cache/hunkboard/$repo/$branch"; [ -f "$out/diff.json" ] || exit 0; "$HUNKBOARD_BIN/hunkboard-publish" --out "$out" >/dev/null && "$HUNKBOARD_BIN/hunkboard-push" --from "$out" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true'
